decision.summary: A correlated transient offset in N and U (498–507) is evident, with asymmetric recovery: U rebounds quickly, N lags, and E shows only a shallow dip without a confirmed opposing return within the allowed context [460,545]. The absence of a complete opposing return on all axes prevents confirmation of a temporary offset; status is uncertain.

intervals.observation: N and U show a correlated multi-sample drop starting ~498, sustained through ~506; E dips more shallowly but does not clearly return opposite to the drop before 507. Return phase is incomplete: U recovers rapidly after 506, N lags and remains depressed at 507, E shows no clear opposing rebound by 507. No full opposing return observed within allowed context.
